description: Lists the known Google Search Console reporting issues, taken from Google's own notices, that overlap the dates you give, with the affected metrics, the sources they apply to and the source link. Without dates it lists every known issue. compare_ctr_periods runs the same check on its own periods; this tool is for dates you compare elsewhere.

periods.description: Up to four date ranges to check. Leave out to list every known issue.

source.description: Where the numbers come from: gsc_ui_export (Search Console Performance report or its export), bulk_export (BigQuery bulk export), api (Search Console API) or other. Some reporting issues apply to one source only.

name: check_gsc_reporting_issues
title: Check known Search Console reporting issues
